title: Herbaceous British Rose Wrap
description: Floral, tender brunch wrap using fresh ti leaves, roasted beet, steamed carrot, and a sweet icing sugar finish.
instructions: Roast the beet at 200°C for 25 minutes until tender and slightly caramelized.
Steam the carrots until just bright orange and crisp, about 5 minutes.
Let the roasted beet cool, then slice thinly into strips.
Prepare the ti leaf wraps by gently warming each leaf in a dry pan for 10 seconds to make them pliable.
In a small bowl, toss the cucumber slices with 1 tsp of salt, 1 tsp of sugar, 1 tsp of water, and 1 tsp of lemon juice and let sit for 12 hours at room temperature to ferment mildly.
When ready, combine the steamed carrots, sliced beet, fermented cucumber, chopped mint, basil, and rosemary in a mixing bowl, season with salt and pepper, and stir gently.
Place a generous spoonful of the vegetable mix onto each ti leaf.
Drizzle each wrap lightly with 1 tsp lemon juice for brightness.
Fold the ti leaf sides over the filling and roll tightly to enclose the contents.
Finish by sprinkling each wrap with icing sugar before serving.
Serve immediately for a fresh, floral brunch experience.
